items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 13:1
items.html: It is by force of the lower Hei that rose to the forehead, meaning to Keter, where the root of the Partzuf is. There it received great force and strength, so that even at the time of the coupling of Gadlut, when a new light descends and breaks through the Parsa, the Parsa nonetheless remains in its existence, and the boundary is not annulled — only an illumination expands and connects the AHP to the degree. (Inner Light, page 616, Sub Header, “And Behold You”)
